item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00129","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C01","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives use a sequence of recitals praising a distinguished public servant, state that naming a major federal place or facility for him is fitting, and conclude with nearly identical machinery designating the existing entity by the honoree's name and declaring that it shall thereafter be known by that name. C01 and C17 share designation language, but their statutory agency-designation function is materially different and more generic.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS the public service of John Foster Dulles, the renowned diplomat and statesman, was dedicated in large measure to the ideals of democracy and the cause of freedom and peace throughout the world","parent_excerpt":"Whereas Gifford Pinchot, the first Chief of the Forest Service... was primarily responsible for the establishment of our national-forest system... and Whereas his life was spent almost wholly in the service of the public","explanation":"Both establish the honoree's distinguished public service and accomplishments as the basis for the naming action."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS it is fitting that the international airport being built to serve our Nation's Capital should bear the name of this distinguished American","parent_excerpt":"Whereas it is especially appropriate to pay tribute to Gifford Pinchot by naming one of our great national forests in his honor","explanation":"These recitals express the same specific rationale: honoring a distinguished American by attaching his name to a prominent federal place."},{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate the airport... as the Dulles International Airport; and such airport shall hereafter be known and referred to by that name.","parent_excerpt":"the Columbia National Forest... is hereby designated and hereafter shall be known as the Gifford Pinchot National Forest.","explanation":"The operative clauses use closely parallel language and the same administrative machinery to rename an existing federal entity."}]}
